channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Eight air strikes hit airbase in Syria’s Idlib
item.description: Syrian state TV quotes military source as saying Israeli forces carried out attack, causing damage and no casualties.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 10 in Kharkiv as Ukrainian drones hit Moscow
item.description: Russian attacks reportedly killed 10 people and injured eight in Ukraine's Kharkiv.

item.title: Vessel hit by ‘unknown projectile’ in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
item.description: British maritime agency says the incident caused one casualty and damaged the vessel's engine room.

item.title: Trump says N Korea’s Kim has responded to his request for a conversation
item.description: US president says conversations with Kim Jong Un at a 'positive' stage and slams Seoul for refusing to join war on Iran.

item.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
item.description: The alleged shooter, also a student, later took his own life.

item.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
item.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

item.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
item.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.
